claims.claim: Ranked No. 116 entering Wimbledon 2026 as a wild card
claims.note: ATP bio: 'Entered 2026 Wimbledon as World No. 116'. Wild card status is in the LTA and ATP text.

claims.claim: Beat Dzumhur, Virtanen, Bergs, Dimitrov and Cobolli on the run
claims.note: LTA lists these five wins before the semi-final.

claims.claim: Fifth British man to reach the Wimbledon semi-final in the Open era; second men's wild card after Ivanisevic in 2001
claims.note: ATP bio states both points.

claims.claim: Round of 16 win over Grigor Dimitrov, a former world No. 3, after a marathon match
claims.note: Info.fr: 'huitième de finale marathon contre l'ancien numéro 3 mondial Grigor Dimitrov'.

claims.claim: Flavio Cobolli was the ninth seed and the quarter-final opponent
claims.note: LTA: 'set to take on ninth seed Flavio Cobolli in the Wimbledon quarter-final'.

claims.claim: Zverev, second seed and Roland Garros champion, beat Fery 7-6(0), 6-2, 6-4 in 2h15 in the semi-final
claims.note: LTA quotes the scoreline and the duration.

claims.claim: Born 12 July 2002 in Sevres, Hauts-de-Seine, France
claims.note: Info.fr states the date and place. The ATP bio shows the place but not the date, so the date rests on one press source.

claims.claim: Birthplace Sevres, France
claims.note: ATP bio: 'Born in Sèvres, France.'

claims.claim: Born near Paris, has lived mostly in London
claims.note: The Connexion: born in Sèvres near Paris, lived in London most of his life.

claims.claim: Moved to Wimbledon at one month old and grew up in London
claims.note: LTA: moved to Wimbledon when he was a month old.

claims.claim: Said he is proud to be English, and that saying so in French feels strange (paraphrase of a quote)
claims.note: The Connexion quote: 'I'm proud to be English [and] it feels strange to say that in French'.

claims.claim: Holds French and British nationality
claims.note: Info.fr: 'possède la double nationalité française et britannique'.

claims.claim: Represents Great Britain
claims.note: The Connexion: 'representing Great Britain'.

claims.claim: Mother Olivia Fery was a pro player in the 1991 Roland Garros women's doubles draw
claims.note: ATP bio states this.

claims.claim: Davis Cup debut for Great Britain in 2025, win over Poland
claims.note: LTA: debut for Lexus GB Davis Cup team in a win over Poland in 2025.

claims.claim: Represented Great Britain at the 2019 European Championships
claims.note: ATP bio: 'Represented Great Britain in European Championships in 2019.'

claims.claim: Kings College School, Stanford college tennis, two-time ITA All-American, first Stanford No. 1 since Bob Bryan in 1998
claims.note: ATP bio states these.

claims.claim: Challenger record 49-31 with two finals lost
claims.note: ATP bio: 'Owns 49-31 Challenger record (0-2 in finals)'.

claims.claim: First tour-level match at Wimbledon 2023 as a wild card, lost in round one to No. 3 Medvedev
claims.note: ATP bio: 'Made tour-level debut at 2023 Wimbledon as a WC', losing to No. 3 Medvedev in the first round.

claims.claim: LTA gives ranking No. 114 going into Wimbledon; ATP gives No. 116; LTA cites career high No. 36 in live rankings
claims.note: LTA: 'ranked No.114'; 'career-high of world No.36 in the live rankings'. ATP: 'World No. 116'. Both figures are shown with their sources.

claims.claim: Malibu M25 title was his third ITF singles title in six months, beating Alex Michelsen 6-4 2-6 6-4
claims.note: ITF article: third title in six months at M25 Malibu; title match 6-4 2-6 6-4 over Michelsen. The article's 2023 year is taken from its headline.

claims.claim: At the Australian Open, as a qualifier, beat 20th seed Flavio Cobolli 7-6(1), 6-4, 6-1; ranked 185 then
claims.note: Flashscore: win over Cobolli 7-6(1), 6-4, 6-1 on John Cain Arena, came through qualifying, ranked 185. The article gives no year; the page places it before Wimbledon 2026 because it refers to Wimbledon 'last year'.

claims.claim: Height 175 cm and right-handed
claims.note: Australian Open profile: '175 cm', 'Right Handed'.

claims.claim: Country listed as United Kingdom
claims.note: Australian Open profile lists the United Kingdom.

summary: Todas as afirmações verificadas coincidem com as fontes citadas. A data de nascimento depende de um único artigo de imprensa francês; o perfil da ATP não a mostra.
